global.headline: Nooks secures $500 million commitment to expand AI sales tools
global.source_title: AI sales startup Nooks secures $500 million in funding for expansion
global.summary: Nooks announced a $500 million commitment from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund for sales, marketing and product expansion. The arrangement shares returns generated by the capital instead of buying equity; Nooks also launched its Revenue Agent Platform.

global.headline: US ballot results signal resistance to data-centre expansion
global.source_title: In midterm ballot measures, voters send a message to AI builders
global.summary: Reuters reports that all but one of 41 data-centre ballot measures went against development, citing Ballotpedia. Newly elected governors in Texas, Georgia and Ohio have promised permit pauses and tighter construction rules, adding uncertainty for AI infrastructure developers.

india.headline: India warns financial firms about AI-assisted cyberattacks
india.source_title: India cybercrime agency warns financial firms of AI-driven cyberattacks
india.summary: India's I4C warned banks and other financial firms that AI agents are accelerating financially motivated attacks. Its advisory recommends payment limits, beneficiary-name checks and monitoring for unusual transaction speeds alongside existing CERT-In safeguards.
